pizzas.name: Rustic Classic
pizzas.desc: Oregano-infused Barrel & Stone tomato sauce and creamy Fior di Latte mozzarella. The one everything else is built on.

pizzas.name: Simply Salami
pizzas.desc: Cured Napoli salami, Barrel & Stone tomato sauce and Fior di Latte.

pizzas.name: The Works
pizzas.desc: Smoked speck ham, Napoli salami and fennel salami over tomato sauce and Fior di Latte.

pizzas.name: Nice & Spicy
pizzas.desc: Calabrian 'nduja laced with chilli, Fior di Latte, sweet piquanté peppers, hot salami and sliced chillies.

pizzas.name: Gone Trufflin'
pizzas.desc: Mushroom and black truffle paste, smoked speck ham, mushrooms and Fior di Latte. No tomato, all depth.

pizzas.name: Rock the Parma
pizzas.desc: 18-month Parma ham, rocket and Parmigiano Reggiano over tomato and Fior di Latte, finished with balsamic glaze.

pizzas.name: Chicken & Pesto
pizzas.desc: Green pesto and garlic base, seared chicken, Fior di Latte, roasted courgettes, capers and pine nuts.

pizzas.name: The Garden Club
pizzas.desc: Tomato and garlic, Fior di Latte, red onion, roasted courgettes, piquanté peppers and a handful of rocket.

pizzas.name: The Vegan
pizzas.desc: Barrel & Stone tomato sauce with Violife vegan mozzarella. Add any veg you like.

sides.name: Garlic bread
sides.desc: Stone-baked base brushed with garlic-infused olive oil.

sides.name: Garlic & mozzarella
sides.desc: Our garlic bread under melted Fior di Latte and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

drinks.name: Local cask and craft beer
drinks.desc: Every Barrel & Stone pub pours at least one beer brewed nearby. Ask at the bar what's on.

drinks.name: Italian red, white and rosé
drinks.desc: Chosen to sit alongside the pizza, by the glass or bottle.
